definitions.explanation: The tendency to put on airs or make things look fancier than they are. Most commonly used in the negative form (飾り気のない) to praise someone or something as unpretentious.

examples.japanese: {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えた→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: I expressed my feelings in plain, unadorned words.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That shop has an unpretentious, relaxed atmosphere.

notes:
USAGE:
{飾|かざ}り{気|け} is overwhelmingly used in the negative pattern {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ or {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, meaning "unpretentious" or "unaffected." This is a compliment, praising natural simplicity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (an unpretentious person)
- {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (plain, honest words)
- {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧ (a natural smile)
- {飾|かざ}り{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to be unpretentious)
